title: Look It Up: Analysing Internal Web Search Capabilities of Modern LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2511.18931v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern large language models increasingly integrate internal web-based retrieval to provide real-time answers, yet it remains unclear how effectively these systems identify information need, trigger retrieval, and use retrieved evidence. To understand these parameters better, we evaluate the necessity and effectiveness of internal web search through an external lens in closed-source LLMs, without access to model parameters or internal configuration. Our evaluation method comprises a static split of 783 temporally anchored factual queries answerable from pre-cutoff knowledge, designed to test whether retrieval is invoked based on factual uncertainty, and a dynamic split of 288 post-cutoff queries that require up-to-date information, designed to evaluate retrieval effectiveness under unavoidable information need. translated_title: 查一查：分析现代大语言模型的内部网络搜索能力
translated_abstract: 现代大语言模型日益集成内部基于网络的检索以提供实时答案，然而这些系统在识别信息需求、触发检索以及利用检索到的证据方面的有效性仍不明确。为了更好地理解这些因素，我们在无法访问模型参数或内部配置的条件下，通过外部视角评估了闭源大语言模型中内部网络搜索的必要性与有效性。我们的评估方法包括一个静态分割，包含783个时间锚定的、可由截止日期前知识回答的事实性查询，旨在测试检索是否基于事实不确定性而被调用；以及一个动态分割，包含288个截止日期后、需要最新信息的查询，旨在评估在不可避免的信息需求下检索的有效性。我们在两个模型家族和不同规模上对四个模型进行了实验。在各模型中，启用检索带来了显著的……
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需访问模型内部的黑盒外部评估方法，利用783个截止日期前的事实性查询（静态）和288个截止日期后的查询（动态），系统分析现代闭源大语言模型内部网络搜索的触发必要性及其检索有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a black-box external evaluation method, using 783 static pre-cutoff factual queries and 288 dynamic post-cutoff queries, to systematically analyze when modern closed-source LLMs trigger internal web search and how effectively they leverage the retrieved evidence.
